🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know your phone camera doesn't just 'take' a photo, it often *builds* it using AI? 🤯

💡 When you snap a photo with your smartphone, it might feel like a single click captures a moment. But behind the scenes, your phone often takes *dozens* of rapid-fire pictures, then uses a tiny AI brain to instantly combine them. It intelligently picks the best parts – like the sharpest details, brightest colors, and clearest faces – to create one perfect, stunning image, all before you even see the final result!
